name: evaluate
title: Evaluate input and capture the output

origin.description: Parse input, evaluate each complete expression, and record source, text, messages, warnings, errors, and plots in order.
origin.usage: evaluate(input, envir = parent.frame(), enclos = NULL, debug = FALSE, stop_on_error = 0L, keep_warning = TRUE, keep_message = TRUE, log_echo = FALSE, log_warning = FALSE, new_device = TRUE, output_handler = default_output_handler, filename = NULL, include_timing = FALSE)

arguments.name: input
arguments.text: Source text or a list of lines.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: Environment for evaluation. The default is a fresh environment.

arguments.name: stop_on_error
arguments.text: 0 continues, 1 returns the results so far, and 2 raises the error.

arguments.name: keep_warning
arguments.text: True stores the warning. False drops it. NA lets it through.

arguments.name: keep_message
arguments.text: True stores the message. False drops it. NA lets it through.

arguments.name: output_handler
arguments.text: Functions called for each kind of output.

arguments.name: include_timing
arguments.text: Deprecated. A true value warns and is ignored.

origin.details: An error inside a semicolon line skips the rest of that line. Separate lines continue when stop_on_error is 0. A top-level warning or error has no call attached. A warning or error inside a function keeps that function.
origin.value: An evaluation: source, text, conditions, values, and recorded plots, in the order they happened.

translation.description: Parse input, evaluate each complete expression, and record source, text, messages, warnings, errors, and plots in order.
translation.usage: evaluate(input, envir=None, *, stop_on_error=0, keep_warning=True, keep_message=True, log_echo=False, log_warning=False, output_handler=None, filename=None, include_timing=False)

arguments.name: input
arguments.text: Source text or a list of lines.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: Environment for evaluation. The default is a fresh environment.

arguments.name: stop_on_error
arguments.text: 0 continues, 1 returns the results so far, and 2 raises the error.

arguments.name: keep_warning
arguments.text: True stores the warning. False drops it. NA lets it through.

arguments.name: keep_message
arguments.text: True stores the message. False drops it. NA lets it through.

arguments.name: output_handler
arguments.text: Functions called for each kind of output.

arguments.name: include_timing
arguments.text: Deprecated. A true value warns and is ignored.

translation.details: An error inside a semicolon line skips the rest of that line. Separate lines continue when stop_on_error is 0. A top-level warning or error has no call attached. A warning or error inside a function keeps that function.
translation.value: An evaluation: source, text, conditions, values, and recorded plots, in the order they happened.
translation.example:
print(evaluate(["1 + 1", "2 + 2"], envir={}))
print(evaluate("1;2;3", envir={}))
print(evaluate(["1", "2", "3"], envir={}))
print(evaluate("1;stop(2);3", envir={}))
print(evaluate(["1", "stop(2)", "3"], envir={}))
